text: Across checkpoints 500-5000 in seed 75, the force margin (0.102 to 0.209) rises roughly linearly in log(val_mse_ratio) (0.39 to 0.005), while accel_step levels off. Pooling all long-trained best-of-5 runs, is the final force margin better predicted by the final log val_mse_ratio than by training step? Would that make force decodability a byproduct of how well the model has converged rather than a separate representational stage?
